selected.caps: The active descriptor and cheap-score block is limited by window_size; policy feature vectors are limited by shortlist_size. Retained and pending layers are additional storage. These parameters do not bound total search memory.
selected.cheap_score: Absolute residual on observed row 0 using the descriptor operator; stable ties use original global grammar ordinal.
selected.execution: Execute shortlisted entries first, then every remaining descriptor in original grammar order exactly once. Complete layers are retained canonically in original generation order; interrupted layers are discarded. No permanent pruning, replay, or duplicate root evaluation.
selected.feature_handling: For the four ranked policy controls, build the unchanged 12 features only for selected entries, using original global ordinal and full layer width. Cheap-only builds no full features.
selected.name: cheap-single-row-shortlist-with-complete-fallback
selected.retention: Within complete layers, deduplicate by (operator, observed-row signature), keeping the canonical earliest generation-order representative.
